title: pinus decaisneana var. wilsonii
intro: Pinus decaisneana var. wilsonii, commonly known as Wilson's pine or Chinese white pine, is a variant of the Pinus decaisneana species found in China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and aiding in the treatment of various conditions such as bronchitis and coughs. The health benefits of Wilson's pine are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Pinus decaisneana var. wilsonii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
